Two queues would be called \"{name}\". Q.pt-BR: Duas queues se chamariam "{name}". Os nomes das queues devem ser únicos.
Two queues would be called \"{name}\". Q.fr: Deux queues s'appelleraient « {name} ». Les noms de queues doivent être uniques.
Two queues would be called \"{name}\". Q.de: Zwei Queues würden "{name}" heißen. Queue-Namen müssen eindeutig sein.

Some targets are outside the parent's ta.es: Algunos targets están fuera de la red target del padre. Una queue hija solo ve el tráfico con el que también coincide su padre.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.pt-BR: Alguns targets estão fora da rede alvo da parent. Uma queue filha só vê o tráfego que a parent também casa.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.fr: Certaines cibles sont en dehors du réseau cible du parent. Une queue enfant ne voit que le trafic que son parent attrape aussi.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.de: Einige Targets liegen außerhalb des Target-Netzes des Parents. Eine Child-Queue sieht nur Verkehr, den auch ihr Parent trifft.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.id: Beberapa target berada di luar jaringan target parent. Queue child hanya melihat lalu lintas yang juga dicocokkan parent-nya.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.it: Alcuni target sono fuori dalla rete target del genitore. Una coda figlia vede solo il traffico che corrisponde anche al genitore.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.tr: Bazı hedefler üst kuyruğun hedef ağının dışında. Alt kuyruk yalnızca üst kuyruğun da eşleştirdiği trafiği görür.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.vi: Một số target nằm ngoài mạng target của hàng đợi cha. Hàng đợi con chỉ thấy lưu lượng mà hàng đợi cha cũng khớp.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.ru: Некоторые цели находятся вне целевой сети родительской очереди. Дочерняя очередь видит только тот трафик, который подходит и родительской.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.pl: Niektóre cele leżą poza siecią docelową kolejki nadrzędnej. Kolejka podrzędna widzi tylko ruch, który pasuje też do nadrzędnej.
Some targets are outside the parent's ta.hi: कुछ टारगेट पैरेंट के टारगेट नेटवर्क के बाहर हैं। चाइल्ड क्यू सिर्फ़ वही ट्रैफ़िक देखती है जो उसके पैरेंट से भी मेल खाता है।

The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).es: Las velocidades de bajada garantizadas (limit-at) suman {sum}, más que los {max} del padre. No se pueden cumplir todas a la vez.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).pt-BR: As taxas de download garantidas (limit-at) somam {sum}, mais que os {max} da parent. Elas não podem ser cumpridas todas ao mesmo tempo.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).fr: Les débits de download garantis (limit-at) totalisent {sum}, soit plus que les {max} du parent. Ils ne peuvent pas tous être respectés en même temps.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).de: Die garantierten Download-Raten (limit-at) summieren sich auf {sum}, mehr als die {max} des Parents. Sie können nicht alle zugleich eingehalten werden.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).id: Jumlah kecepatan download yang dijamin (limit-at) mencapai {sum}, lebih dari {max} milik parent. Semuanya tidak mungkin terpenuhi sekaligus.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).it: Le velocità di download garantite (limit-at) sommano a {sum}, più dei {max} del genitore. Non possono essere rispettate tutte insieme.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).tr: Garanti edilen indirme hızları (limit-at) toplamı {sum}, üst kuyruğun {max} değerinden fazla. Hepsi aynı anda karşılanamaz.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).vi: Tổng tốc độ tải xuống được đảm bảo (limit-at) là {sum}, lớn hơn {max} của hàng đợi cha. Không thể đáp ứng tất cả cùng lúc.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).ru: Гарантированные скорости загрузки (limit-at) в сумме дают {sum}, что больше {max} у родительской очереди. Выполнить их все одновременно невозможно.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).pl: Gwarantowane prędkości pobierania (limit-at) sumują się do {sum}, czyli więcej niż {max} kolejki nadrzędnej. Nie da się zapewnić ich wszystkich naraz.
The guaranteed download rates (limit-at).hi: गारंटीकृत डाउनलोड रेट (limit-at) का जोड़ {sum} है, जो पैरेंट के {max} से ज़्यादा है। सब एक साथ पूरे नहीं हो सकते।

A client's max-limit is above the parent.es: El max-limit de un cliente está por encima del del padre, así que lo que realmente lo limita es el padre.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.pt-BR: O max-limit de um cliente está acima do da parent, então quem realmente o limita é a parent.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.fr: Le max-limit d'un client dépasse celui du parent : c'est donc le parent qui le limite réellement.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.de: Das max-limit eines Clients liegt über dem des Parents, der Parent begrenzt ihn also tatsächlich.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.id: max-limit klien di atas milik parent, jadi parent-lah yang sebenarnya membatasinya.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.it: Il max-limit di un client è superiore a quello del genitore, quindi il limite effettivo è quello del genitore.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.tr: Bir istemcinin max-limit değeri üst kuyruğunkinden yüksek, dolayısıyla asıl sınırlayan üst kuyruktur.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.vi: max-limit của một máy khách cao hơn của hàng đợi cha, nên hàng đợi cha mới là giới hạn thực sự.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.ru: max-limit клиента выше, чем у родительской очереди, поэтому на деле скорость ограничивает родительская.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.pl: Max-limit klienta jest wyższy niż w kolejce nadrzędnej, więc faktycznym ograniczeniem jest kolejka nadrzędna.
A client's max-limit is above the parent.hi: क्लाइंट का max-limit पैरेंट से ऊपर है, इसलिए असली सीमा पैरेंट ही तय करता है।

From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.es: Desde reposo, un cliente descarga a {burst} durante unos {secs} s, y luego a {max}.
From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.pt-BR: A partir do repouso, um cliente baixa a {burst} por cerca de {secs} s e depois a {max}.
From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.fr: Depuis l'inactivité, un client télécharge à {burst} pendant environ {secs} s, puis à {max}.

From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.ru: Из состояния простоя клиент загружает со скоростью {burst} примерно {secs} с, затем со скоростью {max}.
From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.pl: Po bezczynności klient pobiera z prędkością {burst} przez około {secs} s, a potem z {max}.
From idle, a client downloads at {burst}.hi: निष्क्रिय अवस्था से क्लाइंट लगभग {secs} s तक {burst} पर डाउनलोड करता है, फिर {max} पर।

Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.es: Las simple queues se evalúan de arriba hacia abajo; con cientos de clientes, PCQ o un queue tree consume menos CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.pt-BR: As simple queues são avaliadas de cima para baixo; com centenas de clientes, PCQ ou uma queue tree custa menos CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.fr: Les simple queues sont évaluées de haut en bas ; avec des centaines de clients, PCQ ou un queue tree coûte moins de CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.de: Simple Queues werden von oben nach unten geprüft; bei Hunderten Clients kosten PCQ oder ein Queue Tree weniger CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.id: Simple queue diperiksa dari atas ke bawah; dengan ratusan klien, PCQ atau queue tree lebih hemat CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.it: Le simple queue vengono controllate dall'alto in basso; con centinaia di client, PCQ o un queue tree consuma meno CPU.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.tr: Simple queue'lar yukarıdan aşağıya denetlenir; yüzlerce istemcide PCQ veya queue tree daha az CPU harcar.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.vi: Simple queue được kiểm tra từ trên xuống dưới; với hàng trăm máy khách, PCQ hoặc queue tree tốn ít CPU hơn.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.ru: Простые очереди проверяются сверху вниз; при сотнях клиентов PCQ или дерево очередей меньше нагружает процессор.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.pl: Simple queue są sprawdzane od góry do dołu; przy setkach klientów PCQ lub drzewo kolejek mniej obciąża procesor.
Simple queues are checked top to bottom;.hi: Simple queues ऊपर से नीचे जाँची जाती हैं; सैकड़ों क्लाइंट होने पर PCQ या queue tree में CPU कम लगता है।
